text:
amanda: Quick sync — dropping a compact proposal for the minimal quality/regression gate we run during new-model bring-up (including quant experiments). Want quick 👍/nits by EOD Monday so QE can schedule runs.

josh: Thanks — will skim now. Main ask: do we have stable eval harness config for quant vs fp32 comparisons?

amanda: Not fully. Proposal includes a locked harness snapshot and a diff job that compares fp32 baseline -> quant variants. See snippet below.

priya: can you paste the pass/fail thresholds? helps to know tight vs permissive.

amanda: Sure — minimal checklist (short):
- smoke: candidate can complete 100 sample prompts without crashes or invalid tokens
- quality delta: mean EM/accuracy drop <= 2% absolute on core prompt-suite OR within 1.5x historical variance
- hallucination check: < 3% flagged hallucinations on NER/QA probes
- latency: p95 increase <= 1.2x baseline for same sequence lengths
- memory OOM: none in 500-run burst with batch sizes matching expected traffic
- eval harness reproducibility: diff job exits 0 and artifacts uploaded

marco: Where do we define the "core prompt-suite"? Is it the onboarding baseline set or product-specific?

ellie: Core prompt-suite = onboarding baseline (200 prompts across NLU/QA/dialog). Product-specific tests are run later in dedicated A/B.

ben: On quant experiments: add a quick token-level perplexity check? sometimes ppl-level metrics hide degens.

amanda: Good call. Add: token-ppl delta <= 5% relative to fp32 on the same batch.

laura: For automation, do we want CI to gate on artifact size (quant model file) and sanity-load time?

ci-bot: CI scheduled: run-harness-175444-gen on queue gpu-large in 10m, artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/1754443211/

josh: Suggestion: make quality thresholds configurable by model family tier (small/medium/large). For fast iteration we can allow relaxed thresholds for experimental families.

amanda: Agreed. Add a tier field in the intake form. Default to "production" thresholds unless intake marks "experimental".

priya: One more: add a minimal adversarial prompt subset to catch tokenization regressions post-quant. 20 prompts should do.

amanda: Added. Final proposed flow:
1) intake form (model family, intended traffic, tier, baseline commit)
2) smoke (sanity run: 100 prompts)
3) harness diff job (fp32 baseline vs quant variants) -> metrics + artifacts
4) pass/fail evaluation (thresholds per tier)
5) QE/perf signoff + rollout plan (canary config)

marco: timeline to get automation in place?

amanda: I can land a harness snapshot and intake form by Tuesday. CI jobs need a small terraform change — josh can estimate.

josh: Will put an ETA for infra changes by EOD.

ellie: QE will reserve runs Wed/Thu if we get the artifacts Monday night.

ben: tiny nit — call out that "no OOM" includes KV cache warmup for seq>2048.

amanda: noted.

laura: LGTM from ops perspective as long as we emit trace ids for failed cases.

amanda: Great — will update intake doc and post final checklist here when done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
